messages:
tess: Starting a quick entitlement sweep focused on admin bindings + unlabeled KMS keys. 72h self-attest, 14d quarantine (console/API disabled), 180d snapshot retention before any destructive ops. Volunteers for owners?

andre: ack. i'll run ownerless scans tonight and upload results. please paste the smallest command set to run.

mohit: short commands I use:
```
# GCP owners
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $P --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role|test("owner|roles/owner"))'
# GCP KMS key list
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --format='csv(name,labels)'
# AWS KMS
aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' --output text | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms describe-key --key-id {}
# Azure KeyVault
az keyvault key list --vault-name $VAULT -o tsv
```

andre: uploaded -> gs://redwood-security/entitlement/3276543210-scan.csv (10 rows). sample: svcacct-data-eng@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com,owner=null; key-legacy-prod,labels=null

tess: propose flow: if no owner in 72h -> label `quarantine:pending` + disable console/API tokens; if still orphaned after 14d -> snapshot to gs/aws-archive, rotate if in use, mark `access:archived` and consult legal before destroy. create temp-proxy SA when resource has live consumers to avoid outage.

elliot: i'll take svcacct-data-eng. mohit you take key-legacy-prod. i'll open infra PR to persist owners in infra/owners.yaml and add a pre-submit check to block new owner bindings without CODEOWNERS signoff.

attest-bot: attestation:run_started ts=3276543210 scope=org module=ownerless_scan

mohit: added remediation notes to runbook: how to create proxy SA, rotation proof artifact path gs://redwood-security/rotations/3276543210/, and terraform snippet to add owner metadata.

legal: quick note: 180d snapshot retention ok for infra entitlements; keys touching customer data require 2yr retention and exec approval.

attest-bot: attestation:run_complete ts=3276543375 status=partial_orphans=10 report=gs://redwood-security/entitlement/3276543210-report.json

tess: thanks — follow-ups: (1) @elliot open infra PR for owners/gating (2) @andre run outreach emails + self-attest form (3) @mohit add proxy SA snippet and proof-of-rotation template. we'll reconvene if >7 orphans after quarantine window.
